title: Design, Erection and Management of DGLL booth at Maritime India Summit-2023 from 17-19 October, 2023 at MMRDA Ground, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai
summary: Request for quotation to design, erect, run and dismantle the DGLL exhibition booth, with LED walls, models, holograms, live NAIS/SCADA/NAVTEX demonstrations and publicity material, at Maritime India Summit 2023, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai. Issued by the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, Noida.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, Noida

sites.name: MMRDA Ground, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai (Maritime India Summit 2023 venue)
sites.work: Design, erection and management of DGLL exhibition booth

scope.item: Floor platform approx. 900 sq ft (9 m x 10 m), 4 inch raised, synthetic woven carpet 3-4 mm
Side pillar fabrication, paint finished MDF ply wooden wall with putty both sides
Fascia fabrication with MDF ply board, putty, colour and finishing
Poster panel fitting with high pixel digital vinyl prints, vinyl cut letters, LED letters and logos
LED wall: P3 wall (20x10) with frame, fitting and technical person, 55 inch TV stand, 3D billboard wall setup
Furnishing and fittings: visitor chairs, system tables, spot/LED par/metal/display/halogen/banner/back lights, rope and LED strip lighting, brochure stand
Labour: carpenters 10 days, electrician 6 days, painters 6 days (16 h/day), supervisor for whole project
3D design of booth, graphics, short/introductory video, vinyl design
Digital signage: hologram fan, AI photo booth, hologram portal, standee
Virtual video VR setup with high resolution video making and technical equipment
Plants, hostess, service boys, technicians, water bottles
Transportation from factory to venue, 4 loading vehicles up and down

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed; Bid Security Declaration (Annexure-1) required with quotation. Rates quoted without GST, GST extra as applicable.

period.completion: Booth for exhibition 17-19 October 2023 including dismantling afterwards

eligibility: Reputed firms; bidder should know procedure to liaise with exhibition authorities for approvals
specs: Booth 9 m x 10 m with Aids to Navigation and satellite theme; stated as '900 Sqm' in scope and 'approx. 900 sq ft' in schedule
6 Nos 55 inch LED TVs/3D billboard wall with laptops; minimum 4 tablets; P3 LED wall 20x10
Live demonstration of SCADA, NAIS and NAVTEX data; models of lighthouse, VTS Gulf of Kutch, satellite and V-sat antenna; working lighthouse tower model at least 4 m high
500 brochures; minimum 600 giveaway souvenirs; minimum 5 display podiums; video and photography; documentation report after exhibition
notes: RFQ with scope (clauses 3.1.1-3.1.33), terms and schedule of work (rates blank). Issued 19.09.2023 with quotations due next day 20.09.2023 15:00; opening 21.09.2023 16:00. Booth area inconsistency: 9 m x 10 m equals 90 sq m, not 900 sq m (scope) or 900 sq ft (schedule). Bid Security Declaration Annexure-1 referenced but not included.
